title: Changes from upstream
description: Why each voicing differs from tombatossals/chords-db v0.6.0 (df06fa7). Every difference must be covered by an entry; see UPSTREAM-DIFF.md.

ids.description: Voicing ids this entry covers. A trailing * matches every id with that prefix ('piano/*', or '*' for all).

kinds.description: Only cover these kinds of difference. Omit to cover every kind.

change.description: What changed and why, in one or two sentences.

pr.description: The pull request in this repository.

upstream.description: Related upstream issue or pull request, e.g. 'tombatossals/chords-db#44'.

reportedBy.description: GitHub login of whoever reported the problem.
